problem_statement: OpenThread has no way for a radio driver to report a radio availability schedule (which slots are available/preferred for Thread when the radio is shared with BT or 2.4GHz WiFi). The new tests drive a radio-availability schedule from the platform and read it back through the RCP spinel property. Required behavior: a radio driver can notify OpenThread that its availability schedule changed and provide a schedule (start time, slot duration, number of slots, and available- and preferred-slots bitmaps); OpenThread surfaces this to the host as the radio-availability spinel property, encoding the bitmaps with the preferred bitmap omitted when it equals the available bitmap and unused trailing bits cleared; it reports an error (not the property) for an unknown slot duration or a schedule whose duration exceeds the maximum; multiple updates before the tasklet runs are coalesced to the latest schedule; and the availability-update path survives a radio-stack reset. Without these symbols and behavior, the radio-availability test cases do not build against the base.
